messages:
maria_sec: Heads up — audit-bot flagged a recent deploy role change as privilege drift and we're seeing intermittent GPU job failures this morning. paste of logs below.

sam_infra: thanks, tag me. which deploy?

maria_sec: 2102500227 pipeline -> service-account: deploy-runner@infra. Change merged yesterday by @kevin_runtime.

kevin_runtime: yep, I lifted a role temporarily to unblock a rollout, thought it was scoped. oops. exactly what errors are you seeing?

maria_sec: pods hitting mount errors and KMS decrypt denies. snippet: 
```
E0320 09:12:05  kubelet.go:123] mount failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = access denied to /dev/nvidia0
level=error ts=2026-03-20T09:12:06Z ctx=requestid=abc123 msg="kms.Decrypt failed" error="rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=kms:Decrypt denied for key projects/rdw-kms/cryptoKeys/gpu-cache"
```

junaid_oncall: oncall saw spikes in GPU queue timeouts ~09:10–09:30. many retries.

audit-bot: rule=rbac-drift severity=high user=kevin_runtime resource=ClusterRoleBinding/deploy-runner-binding diff=added: storage.admin, kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter

sam_infra: can we confirm whether the role change granted kms:Decrypt or if it expected workload identity?

kevin_runtime: I had added clusterrole binding to the deploy-runner SA to test bulk uploads. I added a legacy binding that includes storage.admin and attached a KMS decrypter perm. I planned to remove it after smoke.

maria_sec: this is classic ephemeral-privilege leak. we need an incident triage:
- rotate the affected KMS key's version or schedule a key rotation (short term)
- remove the extra ClusterRoleBinding immediately (mitigation)
- audit all recent rolebinding changes and list who granted what (postmortem)

sam_infra: I'm removing the binding now:
```
# run by sam_infra at 09:34
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding deploy-runner-binding
```

deploy-bot: run: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding deploy-runner-binding -> status: accepted by controller, completed in 2s

maria_sec: thanks. please also check for any service accounts that got impersonation permissions. if someone used impersonation, we should rotate tokens and check kube-audit for impersonation calls.

kevin_runtime: full ack. I'll open a PR to revert the temporary change and add a checklist so this doesn't slip through again.

junaid_oncall: monitoring note: I'll add an alert for kms:Decrypt denied spikes and GPU scheduler backlog > 5m.

maria_sec: can we also push an automated audit query to list clusterrolebindings created in the last 48h with kms or storage perms? suggestion: use this gcloud audit filter: `protoPayload.methodName="google.iam.admin.v1.CreateBinding" OR resourceName:"cryptoKeys/"`

sam_infra: will do. initial query returned one other suspicious binding in staging; tagging infra-owners for follow-up.

maria_sec: long term remediation proposals:
- enforce least-privilege via a validated role template for deploy pipelines (no direct kms/storage admin)
- require PR + two approvals for any clusterrolebinding with storage/KMS perms
- add an admission webhook that blocks clusterrolebinding with wide perms unless approved

kevin_runtime: +1 on the role template. I'll take ownership of the PR.

maria_sec: I will own the postmortem and remediation checklist. add timeline to incident tracker and link audit logs.

junaid_oncall: closing loop: are there any active compromised keys or creds we need to rotate now?

sam_infra: we've queued a key rotation for the affected key and rotated the deploy-runner SA token. will confirm rotation completion in 30m.

maria_sec: thanks team. after rotations and binding removal, let's meet for a 30m postmortem at 10:15 to capture lessons and add guardrails. :white_check_mark:
